title: "Data"
shift-heading-level-by: 1

<!--
One include, deliberately. data/README.md is the single source of truth for every
fact about the data, and it stays browsable on GitHub at its own path. Restating any
of it here would create a second copy that drifts. The "!data/README.md" entry in
_quarto.yml's render list stops Quarto also emitting it as a standalone page.

shift-heading-level-by pushes the included file's headings down one level, so its
own H1 becomes an H2 beneath this page's title instead of a second H1 competing with
it. Without the shift the page opens with "Data" immediately followed by an equally
sized "Data — NASA IMS bearing vibration"; dropping the frontmatter title instead
leaves an empty title element and a lowercase browser tab. The shift is the only one
of the three that produces a correct heading hierarchy without editing the source
file, which has to keep its H1 to read properly on GitHub.
-->

{{< include data/README.md >}}
